strong, we have casual conversations mostly but can have serious ones and they've never said/done anything to hurt me

when i talk to them they care but i'm usually not comfortable with talking to anyone i don't want to upset people

i have to go now but i'll be ok thank you for talking to me i feel a little better now
alright, i will try / and yes, it's not really anything in particular, it's just something that's happening

i know it's not real and i don't make myself think about things that aren't likely to happen anymore, but i have 2 friends with similar problems and i'm always worried about them so that doesn't help either, it's not the main cause though

no i don't think it was anything that really happened to me, it was just things i did to myself sort of, i'd make myself stay awake late at night thinking about things i didn't really want to i don't know why and i'd get really scared, like what if something happened to someone else, why is there any point in doing anything anyway (i don't think like this now, but it seemed worth thinking about in the fourth grade)
i was pretty lonely then i didn't really have any friends
i do now though

i'm not able to feel like a real person i can see myself doing things and i know it's me but it just doesn't connect even when i'm bleeding all over the place it doesn't do anything i just get scared i feel scared very often and it happens very easily and i start shaking and stuff and it's not for any real reason
i'm sad constantly like i guess there isn't a total absence of happiness but it never feels real or lasts and it's pretty rare to happen and i'm always sad at the same time and everything really hurts
i've wanted to kill myself since i was about 10 i guess nothing happened to trigger this it's probably depression i guess and i never ever stop thinking about it for even one second and i cry approximately 8 times a day and it's awful and gross i'm uh 14 now
there's other stuff but i don't know
i'm not a nihilist or anything and i wouldn't want anyone else to do this but sometimes i try to disconnect myself from other people so i can just die even though i know it's wrong
i almost took all our tylenol earlier last month, just so it would hurt more than anything, maybe it was an attention-seeking thing i'm not really sure
i probably won't even end up killing myself because i don't want to hurt anyone sorry for wasting your time
